action_instruction: Confirming the demo bank access and nested account list remain displayed
intent: PRIMARY: confirm the visible Demo bank access and its nested account listing remain displayed
rationale: The bank access and all associated accounts are visibly listed together.

action_instruction: Checking whether the Demo bank access is listed
intent: whether the Demo bank access is listed

action_params.query: whether the Demo bank access is listed

action_instruction: Checking whether Demo bank accounts are listed
intent: whether accounts associated with the Demo bank access are listed with it

action_params.condition: the accounts associated with the "Demo bank" access are listed with it
action_params.query: whether accounts associated with the Demo bank access are listed with it
action_params.code_js: (() => { const access = el(16).querySelector('button'); const accounts = [...el(16).querySelectorAll('a[href*="/view/account/"]')]; return !!access && access.textContent.trim() === 'Demo bank' && accounts.length > 0 && accounts.every(a => a.textContent.trim().length > 0); })()

assertion_tree.description: the "Demo bank" access is listed and its accounts are listed with it

sub_results.description: the accounts associated with the "Demo bank" access are listed with it

assertion_tree.verification: The bank-access listing shows the "Demo bank" access together with its associated accounts.
